build_MemoryAccess: build a DNC MemoryAccess module with configurable memory size, word size, and read write heads
create_erase_and_write: create a TensorFlow operation to erase and write values to external memory using address weights
review_MemoryAccess_state_size: review the MemoryAccess state_size property to inspect tensor shapes for memory, read and write weights
test_MemoryAccess_output_size: test the MemoryAccess output_size property to verify the read head output tensor shape
summarize_AccessState: summarize the AccessState namedtuple structure containing memory, read weights, write weights, linkage, and usage fields
